svg.title: Figure 2(b) analogue · Packet delay versus throughput
svg.desc: Mean end-to-end delay of delivered application packets on a logarithmic axis.

g.text: Figure 2(b) analogue · Packet delay versus throughput
1 AP · 1 STA · Periodic downlink · Each dot is a packet-size, interval and seed combination
Window backlog can grow after delivery throughput levels off.
Pending and dropped packets do not enter mean delay. P95, P99 and backlog are in the run CSV.
